title: MojoBPF cost record (test-contracts-v1)
description: One measured cost attached to a case result. Metric values are numeric or explicitly unavailable with a reason, never a fabricated zero. Numeric budgets live in a separate size-budget record owned by later cost work; this schema carries measurements only. Unknown fields are rejected.

schema_version.description: Cost schema version; test-contracts-v1 reads version 1 only.

metric.description: Metric name (for example reachable_slots, executable_bytes, jit_bytes).

unit.description: Unit name (for example slots, bytes, microseconds).

value.description: Measured value; null exactly when unavailable_reason explains the absence.

unavailable_reason.description: Required exactly when value is null.

basis.description: Measurement conditions pinning the number to one artifact and profile.
